YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Car locks & replacement keys

Ask about car lockouts, faulty vehicle locks and replacement keys. Share the make, model and year so the locksmith can check the work required.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry

Vehicle details come first

Car locks and keys vary by vehicle and key system. Provide the make, model, year and whether you still have a working key. Availability of a suitable service is confirmed for your vehicle before a visit.

Locked keys or a faulty lock

Explain whether the keys are inside the vehicle, missing, broken, or no longer operating the lock. Do not force a key or try to prise a door open; this can damage the lock or bodywork.

Replacement key enquiries

Say whether you need a spare or have lost every key. A clear description of the existing key, when available, helps the locksmith check the appropriate next step. Do not post sensitive key or security details publicly.
